2) Last-mile smoke checklist (attached): network, KV-cache warm, TLS certs bound, and observability hooks verified.

Can ACME Ops confirm site contact and expected maintenance window (start/end)? Irene and Marcus: if you see any outstanding runbook items that absolutely must land before the flip, call them out here.

Folks — quick checklist update after today's runbook dry-run:
- Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BcExampleRunbooks
- Network: BGP sessions and transit ACLs are validated in staging. Expect same CIDR mappings on the floor.
- Firewall change: ACME needs one egress rule opened for 52.24.16.0/24 (Redwood metrics egress). ACME Ops — can you confirm you will add this before the window?
- KV-cache warm: we have a staged prefix-warm plan, but we need the ability to run a targeted warmup after the traffic cut. Marcus will coordinate an API key for that.

Attachments: smoke-run-coverage.csv

If ACME cannot add the egress rule we will fallback to a relay in the same region which increases token latency — need final decision by 04/08 18:00 UTC.

Irene
Irene Choi
SRE, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, ACME Ops <ops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gatepass clearance & final smoke verification for ACME on-prem deployment

Post-cutover quick results (executed within the maintenance window):

- Network fabric: PASS — BGP established to both leaf routers; transit metrics stable.
- TLS cert binding: PASS — certs rotated and bound to gateway (no cert alerts).
- KV-cache warm: PARTIAL — prefix warm succeeded for 60% of hot keys. Background priming showed slow steady improvement but one pod failed to accept priming due to a kernel OOM on the host (container restarted).
- Observability: PASS — traces show expected startup spikes; log pipeline saw no data loss.
- Fallback exercised: PASS — relay exercised for 10 minutes, latency 18% higher but within acceptable SLO for <5% of requests.

Attachments: smoke-run-results.log

Action items raised:
1) Infra - investigate host OOM and apply constrained cgroup to the priming container (owner: Marcus).
2) Runbook - add a sub-step to re-run targeted prefix warm on failed pod only (owner: Irene).
3) ACME - confirm egress rule was applied; if not, accept relay longer-term (owner: ACME Ops).

I'll keep the bridge open for 2 hours for any rollforward requests.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, ACME Ops <ops@acme-corp.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 17:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gatepass clearance & final smoke verification for ACME on-prem deployment

Thanks everyone for the rapid execution and clear notes. Summary & next steps for the record: 

- Cutover: completed during 2027-04-09 02:00-04:00 UTC. Gatepass and on-site escort confirmed.
- Current state: service healthy; minor degraded warmup on one pod. No customer-facing errors observed.
- Actions: Marcus to file INF-2027-041 (host oom remediation) and schedule a hotfix; Irene to update the runbook with the targeted re-warm step; ACME Ops to confirm egress rule (please reply to confirm).

I'll close the bridge at 19:00 UTC unless someone requests extra monitoring. If ACME confirms the egress rule applied, we'll decommission the relay in 48 hours and run a final warm pass.

Thanks, great work team.

Soojin Lee
